Shri Abhishek Bhadoriya - Pp for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is first application filed under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.88/2025 registered at Police Station - Satanwada, District - Shivpuri, (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Examination Act.

2. The allegation against the present applicant/accused is that he along with other co-accused persons committed fraud and conspiracy in the examination of Madhya Pradesh Police Constable (GD and Radio) Examination, 2023.

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Police Constable (GD and Radio) Examination, 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The present applicant was the middleman and he arranged the dummy candidate to sit and writ the examination in place of original candidates.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He is in custody since 14.06.2025.
He has not committed any fraud.
Under similar set of facts and allegations some other accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:25047 2 MCRC-29426-2025 this Court.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has already been filed.
Therefore, custodial interrogation is no more required.
Applicant is the permanent resident of Police Station Noorsarai, District Nalanda (Bihar), therefore there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
Under these grounds, counsel for applicant prayed for bail.

4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal and submitted that the applicant bears criminal record of one more case.
